outlook: Soybeans led grains lower overnight: November beans fell about 15 cents to a two-month low after Lula's surprise win in Brazil's presidential runoff sent the Brazilian real sharply lower and funds sold soybeans alongside it. December corn slipped 3 cents to its lowest since mid-July as harvest moves quickly and crude oil eased about 2% to near $101 a barrel. Wheat was steady after an eighth straight weekly loss, with Chicago up slightly and Minneapolis spring wheat down about a penny; USDA also said a processing error affected September corn data for Kansas and Nebraska but its October yield and production estimates stand. ICE canola eased about C$4.60 with the softer soy complex and crude.
